English.SKILL_DESC_60008211: Reduces Crit Resistance of enemies inflicted with [Ignite] by 500.
English.SKILL_DESC_60008220: Each hit reduces enemy's Mana by {1}. Against Bosses, reduces Mana by 500 instead.
English.SKILL_DESC_60008230: [Blazing Storm] reduces the target's Mana by 100 each hit.
English.SKILL_DESC_8240:
Isolet recovers [64ff64]{3}[-] Mana every time she uses a Skill, and increases her Crit DMG by [64ff64]{2}[-]%.
When she creates [64ffff][Explosive Reaction][-], her ATK increases by [64ff64]{4}[-]%. This effect can be stacked up to max [64ffff]{5}[-] times and is irremovable.
When she creates [64ff64][Blazing Storm][-], M.DMG all allies take is reduced by [64ff64]{6}[-]%. This effect can be stacked up to max [64ffff]{7}[-] times and is irremovable.
English.SKILL_DESC_91008240: [Quintessence of Technomagic] Increases the max number of stacks of [Explosive Reaction] by {1} and the max number of stacks of [Blazing Storm] by {2}. Increases Crit DMG by {3}%. Gains 1 additional stack every time [Explosive Reaction] is created.
English.SKILL_DESC_93008202: Increases Isolet's DMG dealt to non-Hero enemies by {1}% and reduces her Cooldown of active Skills by 1 sec every sec for the duration of soul.
